description: NETSOL Technologies Limited is a Pakistani software company that builds asset-finance and leasing systems for banks, captives and equipment financiers, and says it has worked with more than 200 finance and leasing companies in over 30 countries. Its development base is in Lahore, with subsidiaries and delivery offices in the United Kingdom, United States, Thailand, China, Australia, Ireland and Pakistan. The company also sells consultancy and IT services alongside its own software platforms.
headOffice: NETSOL IT Village, Lahore Ring Road, Ghazi Road Interchange, Lahore Cantt., Pakistan
